item.title: Nov 4 · Preparando el asado · Drill
item.description:
1. Well, I'm really tired today because I didn't sleep at all last night.
    Bueno, hoy estoy muy cansado porque anoche no dormí nada.
  2. I went to the supermarket and bought lots of things for the barbecue.
    Fui al supermercado y compré muchas cosas para el asado.
  3. My friend Martín says he's going to come tomorrow if he has time.
    Mi amigo Martín dice que va a venir mañana si tiene tiempo.
  4. I want him to bring his guitar because it's really fun when he plays.
    Quiero que traiga su guitarra, porque es muy divertido cuando toca.
  5. Then I have to take the bus to go to work.
    Después tengo que tomar el colectivo para ir al laburo.
  6. But I don't know what time it leaves.
    Pero no sé a qué hora sale.
